design.title: Design
design.summary: The Design tab of the left dock holds the drawing and modeling tools as titled groups of icons. Click an icon to open its form or run it at once.

fields.name: Design
fields.text: The dock tab down the left edge that shows this page; F11 also switches to the design layout.

fields.name: File Operations
fields.text: Job Setup, Open File, importing vectors, bitmaps and 3D models, and exporting the model as STL.

fields.name: Create Vectors
fields.text: Tools that draw circles, rectangles, lines, arcs, text and dimensions, or trace a bitmap.

fields.name: Transform Objects
fields.text: Move, size, rotate, mirror, distort and align the selection; Vector Unwrapper shows on rotary jobs only.

fields.name: Edit Objects
fields.text: Selection, node editing and transform modes, grouping, measuring, welding, trimming, joining and fixing vectors.

fields.name: Align Objects
fields.text: Center or line up the selection; shows only with Show common tools on drawing tab turned on.

fields.name: Offset and Layout
fields.text: Offset outlines and make arrays, circular copies, copies along vectors or nested layouts.

fields.name: Joinery
fields.text: Opens the Joint Creator for joints between flat parts.

fields.name: Modeling Tools
fields.text: Make relief components from vectors and bitmaps, then change, combine, split and sculpt them.

fields.name: Tool icons
fields.text: A pressed icon marks the open form or the current editing mode; a grayed icon cannot be used now.

fields.name: Tooltips
fields.text: Resting on an icon shows its name, its shortcut key in brackets and a line saying what it does.

fields.name: Create Flat Plane
fields.text: Opens its form; Shift-click adds a zero plane at once instead.

fields.name: Switch to the machining layout (F12)
fields.text: The first title button: switches to the layout with the Toolpaths panel pinned.

fields.name: Help
fields.text: The ? title button opens help on the form open in the dock, or on this page.

fields.name: Auto hide the tool panel
fields.text: The pin button: unpinned, the panel hides and slides out while the pointer is over a dock tab.

fields.name: Keep the tool panel open
fields.text: The pin button while auto hide is on: click to pin the panel open beside the view again.

fields.name: Drag to resize the tool panel
fields.text: The inner edge of the dock: drag it, or use the arrow keys, to change the panel width.

fields.name: Show additional file operations (New, Save, Undo and Redo on the Design tab)
fields.text: The Preferences option that adds a row of New, Save, Undo and Redo icons at the top.

steps: Click the Design tab on the left edge of the window.
Rest the pointer on an icon to read what it does.
Click the icon to open its form in the dock, or to run it.
Close the form to return to the tool groups.

sheets.title: Sheets
sheets.summary: Lists every sheet of the job with its size and contents. Use it to add, edit, rename, duplicate or delete sheets and to pick the active one.

fields.name: Sheets in the job
fields.text: Each row shows the sheet name, its size and thickness, and how many vectors and components it holds.

fields.name: Click a row
fields.text: Selects the sheet; Cmd or Ctrl-click adds or removes one, Shift-click selects a range.

fields.name: Double click a row
fields.text: Makes that sheet the active sheet, the one the views show and you draw on.

fields.name: Keyboard
fields.text: Arrow keys move through the rows, Enter activates, Space selects, F2 renames, Delete removes.

fields.name: Add New
fields.text: Adds a sheet the size of each selected sheet, or of the active sheet when none is selected.

fields.name: Edit
fields.text: Changes the size, thickness and datum of the selected sheets.

fields.name: Delete
fields.text: Deletes the selected sheets and everything on them; a job always keeps at least one sheet.

fields.name: Edit Sheet...
fields.text: Right click menu: opens the sheet editor for this sheet or the selected sheets.

fields.name: Rename
fields.text: Right click menu: type a new name for the sheet in its row.

fields.name: Make Active Sheet
fields.text: Right click menu: makes this sheet active; grayed when it already is.

fields.name: Duplicate Sheet
fields.text: Right click menu: adds a copy of the sheet.

fields.name: Move Selected Objects Here
fields.text: Right click menu: moves the selected vectors and component to this sheet; needs a selection on another sheet.

fields.name: Delete Sheet
fields.text: Right click menu: deletes the sheet or the selected sheets, after asking when they hold objects.

fields.name: New Sheet
fields.text: Right click menu: adds a new sheet sized like the clicked or selected sheets.

fields.name: Sheet Size
fields.text: In the sheet editor: Width (X), Height (Y) and Thickness (Z) of the sheet.

fields.name: Scale design with sheet size
fields.text: In the sheet editor: stretches the vectors and components on each sheet to its new size.

fields.name: Z Zero Position
fields.text: In the sheet editor: whether Z zero is the material surface or the machine bed.

fields.name: XY Datum Position
fields.text: In the sheet editor: the corner or center used as XY zero, with Datum Offset X and Y.

steps: Open the Sheets tab on the left edge of the window.
Click Add New to make another sheet.
Select a sheet and click Edit to change its size.
Double click a sheet to work on it.

layers.title: Layers
layers.summary: Lists the layers of the job. Set the color, visibility, lock and order of each layer, pick the active layer and move objects between layers.

fields.name: Add
fields.text: Opens Add New Layer to name a new layer and pick its color.

fields.name: Show All
fields.text: Makes every layer visible.

fields.name: Hide All
fields.text: Hides every layer.

fields.name: Hide Empty
fields.text: Toggles hiding layers that hold no objects.

fields.name: Drag to reorder
fields.text: Drag a row by its grip onto another row to change the layer order.

fields.name: Layer color
fields.text: The color swatch sets the color the layer's vectors are drawn in.

fields.name: Visible
fields.text: The eye button shows or hides the layer's objects.

fields.name: Locked
fields.text: The lock button stops the layer's objects from being picked in the view.

fields.name: Set active
fields.text: Click a layer name to make it active; new objects go on the active layer.

fields.name: Rename layer
fields.text: Double click a layer name to type a new one; Enter keeps it, Esc cancels.

fields.name: Keep-out
fields.text: Marks a keep-out layer: its closed vectors are areas the tool must stay out of.

fields.name: Move selection to this layer
fields.text: Moves the selected objects onto this layer; needs a selection.

fields.name: Duplicate layer with its objects
fields.text: Adds a copy of the layer and everything on it.

fields.name: Move up
fields.text: Moves the layer one place up the list; Move down moves it one place down.

fields.name: Delete layer
fields.text: Deletes the layer and its objects, asking first when it holds any; one layer always stays.

fields.name: Keep-out Zone
fields.text: Right click menu: makes the layer a keep-out zone; Not a Keep-out Zone turns it back.

fields.name: Select All Vectors on Layer
fields.text: Right click menu: selects every vector on this layer.

fields.name: Merge into Active Layer
fields.text: Right click menu: moves this layer's objects onto the active layer and removes it.

fields.name: Insert Layer Above...
fields.text: Right click menu: adds a new layer just above this one; New Layer... adds one at the end.

steps: Click Add and give the new layer a name.
Click the layer name to make it active.
Draw, or select objects and click Move selection to this layer.
Use the eye and lock buttons to hide or protect layers.

components.title: Components
components.summary: The Component Tree lists the relief components by level, in the order they combine. Reorder, group, show, hide and edit the parts of the 3D model here.

fields.name: Component Tree
fields.text: Levels are folders; within a level the model builds from the bottom of the list up.

fields.name: Up
fields.text: Moves the selected component one place up, later in the combine order.

fields.name: Down
fields.text: Moves the selected component one place down, earlier in the combine order.

fields.name: New Level
fields.text: Adds a new level to hold components.

fields.name: Group
fields.text: Groups the selected components so they combine and move as one.

fields.name: Ungroup
fields.text: Breaks the selected group back into single components.

fields.name: From Visible
fields.text: Creates one component from the visible model.

fields.name: From Vectors
fields.text: Creates a component from the selected vectors.

fields.name: Properties
fields.text: Opens the properties of the selected components, group or level.

fields.name: Delete
fields.text: Deletes the selected components or group.

fields.name: Show check boxes
fields.text: The check box on a level, group or component shows or hides it in the model.

fields.name: Click a row
fields.text: Selects a component; Cmd or Ctrl-click adds or removes one, Shift-click selects a range.

fields.name: Double click a row
fields.text: Opens the properties of the component, or of the level for a level row.

fields.name: Level row
fields.text: Click a level name to make it the active level; the arrow opens or closes it.

fields.name: Combine mode
fields.text: The badge on each row shows how it combines: Add, Subtract, Merge, Low or Multiply.

fields.name: Clipped
fields.text: Badge on a level whose model is clipped to vectors; Mirrored marks a level with a mirror mode.

fields.name: Drag rows
fields.text: Drag to reorder, into a group or onto another level; Alt with an arrow key also moves it.

fields.name: Keyboard
fields.text: F2 renames, Alt with Enter opens properties, Delete removes the selection.

fields.name: Right click menu
fields.text: Offers properties, rename, show or hide, combine mode, move to level, edits, bake, clipping and more.

steps: Select closed vectors and click From Vectors, or use a Modeling Tools form.
Drag components up or down to change how they combine.
Double click a component to change its properties.
Use the check boxes to show or hide parts of the model.

clipart.title: Clipart
clipart.summary: Browse the clipart library of reliefs and vectors and put pieces into the job. Double click a clip or drag it onto a view.

fields.name: Search
fields.text: Shows only clips whose name, category or tags hold every word typed.

fields.name: Scale (%)
fields.text: Size the next inserted clip is scaled to, from 1 to 10000 percent; 100 keeps it as saved.

fields.name: Thumbnails
fields.text: Small, Medium and Large set how big the preview tiles are.

fields.name: Library Folders
fields.text: The folder tree of the library; All shows every clip, a folder shows only its clips.

fields.name: Clip tiles
fields.text: Each tile shows a preview and whether the clip is a Relief or Vectors.

fields.name: Click a tile
fields.text: Selects the clip for Insert.

fields.name: Double click a tile
fields.text: Inserts the clip at the job center.

fields.name: Drag a tile
fields.text: Drop the clip onto the 2D or 3D view to insert it at that spot.

fields.name: Insert
fields.text: Inserts the selected clip at the job center.

fields.name: Rescan
fields.text: Reads the clipart folders again, to pick up clips added outside the app.

fields.name: Your clipart folder
fields.text: Shows the folder where your own clipart is kept.

steps: Open the Clipart tab and pick a library folder or type in Search.
Set Scale (%) if the clip should come in larger or smaller.
Double click a tile, or drag it onto the 2D or 3D view.

toolpaths.title: Toolpaths
toolpaths.summary: The Toolpaths panel on the right shows the material setup, the toolpath operations and the list of calculated toolpaths. Create, order, show, recalculate and save toolpaths here.

fields.name: Material Setup
fields.text: Summary of the material: thickness or diameter, Z Zero, Safe Z and Home Position.

fields.name: Set...
fields.text: Opens the Material Setup form to change the material and machine settings.

fields.name: Toolpath Operations
fields.text: Icons that open each toolpath form, plus editing, templates, preview, summary and saving tools.

fields.name: Switch to the design layout (F11)
fields.text: Title button: switches to the layout with the tool panel pinned.

fields.name: Help
fields.text: The ? title button opens help on the open form, or on this panel.

fields.name: Auto hide the Toolpaths panel
fields.text: Pin button: unpinned, the panel hides to a Toolpaths tab and slides out on hover.

fields.name: Show every toolpath in the list
fields.text: The header check box shows or hides every listed toolpath at once.

fields.name: Sheet
fields.text: Drop-down that lists the toolpaths of one sheet, or All Sheets; picking a sheet makes it active.

fields.name: Move up
fields.text: Moves the selected toolpath one place up the list; Move down moves it down.

fields.name: Show check box
fields.text: The check box on each toolpath shows or hides it in the views.

fields.name: Toolpath row
fields.text: Shows the tool shape, name, status mark and estimated time; click to select it.

fields.name: Double click a toolpath
fields.text: Opens the toolpath's form to edit and recalculate it.

fields.name: Status mark
fields.text: Shows whether the toolpath is Calculated, Needs recalculating, or Calculated, but cuts nothing.

fields.name: Groups
fields.text: Toolpaths can sit in groups; the arrow opens a group and its check box shows all members.

fields.name: Drag toolpaths
fields.text: Drag a toolpath to reorder it, or drop it into or out of a group.

fields.name: Machining Time...
fields.text: Opens the Machining Time Estimate; the line beside it totals the visible toolpaths.

fields.name: Right click a toolpath
fields.text: Show or hide options, Edit, Rename, Duplicate, Recalculate, grouping, Move to a sheet, Save and Delete.

fields.name: Right click a group
fields.text: Rename, Expand, Show or Hide Toolpaths in Group, Recalculate Group, Ungroup and Delete Group...

fields.name: Drag to resize the toolpath list (double click to reset)
fields.text: The bar above the list changes how tall the list is.

steps: Click Set... and check the material thickness and Z zero.
Select vectors, then pick a toolpath operation icon.
Fill in the form and calculate; the toolpath joins the list.
Use the check boxes to pick which toolpaths to preview and save.

view2d.title: 2D View
view2d.summary: The 2D view is where you draw and select vectors. The document bar above it switches views and picks the active sheet, layer and level; the toolbar sets zoom, snapping and display.

fields.name: 2D View (F2)
fields.text: Shows only the 2D view; 3D View (F3) and Assembly View switch to the others.

fields.name: Tile views
fields.text: Two buttons show the 2D and 3D views side by side (Page Up) or stacked (Page Down).

fields.name: Top
fields.text: On double sided jobs, Top and Bottom pick the side to edit; Swap Sides exchanges them.

fields.name: Active sheet
fields.text: Drop-down that picks the active sheet; off while the job has only one.

fields.name: Active layer
fields.text: Drop-down that picks the layer new objects go on; off while there is only one.

fields.name: Active level
fields.text: Drop-down that picks the active component level; off with fewer than two levels.

fields.name: Snap to objects (nodes, midpoints, centers, intersections, job points)
fields.text: Turns snapping to object points on or off.

fields.name: Smart snapping
fields.text: Lines the pointer up with key points of nearby objects while drawing or moving.

fields.name: Snap to grid
fields.text: Snaps the pointer to the grid when nothing else is snapped.

fields.name: Show the component preview
fields.text: Toolbar View group: toggles components drawn in the 2D view; nearby buttons toggle bitmaps and toolpaths.

fields.name: Zoom box
fields.text: Toolbar tool: drag a box to zoom into it (Z); Pan drags the view.

fields.name: Zoom To Job (F6)
fields.text: Fits the material in the view; Zoom To All and Zoom To Selection (Cmd or Ctrl+F) sit beside it.

fields.name: Snap Settings (F4)
fields.text: Opens the snap settings; Snap to guides toggles snapping to guide lines.

fields.name: Show grid
fields.text: Toolbar Display group: toggles the grid; Show rulers and Clear guides sit beside it.

fields.name: Zoom and pan
fields.text: The mouse wheel zooms at the pointer; drag with the middle or right button, or hold Space, to pan.

fields.name: Select
fields.text: Click an object to select it; Shift adds, Cmd or Ctrl toggles, Esc clears the selection.

fields.name: Selection box
fields.text: Dragging right selects objects fully inside; dragging left also selects objects it touches.

fields.name: Guides
fields.text: Drag from a ruler to add a guide; drag it back onto a ruler to delete it; double click edits it.

fields.name: Right click
fields.text: A right click without moving opens the drawing menu: undo, clipboard, grouping, zoom and more.

steps: Pick the active sheet and layer in the document bar.
Draw with a Create Vectors tool, or click objects to select them.
Scroll to zoom and middle drag or hold Space to pan.
Right click for the drawing menu.

view3d.title: 3D View
view3d.summary: The 3D view shows the model, vectors, toolpaths and material block in three dimensions. Turn, pan and zoom it with the mouse or the toolbar and cube.

fields.name: 3D View (F3)
fields.text: The document bar tab that shows only the 3D view; the tile buttons show it beside the 2D view.

fields.name: Isometric View
fields.text: Toolbar button that turns the camera to a corner view.

fields.name: View from Top
fields.text: Toolbar buttons look straight at the model from Top, Front, Back, Left, Right or Bottom.

fields.name: Zoom to Fit
fields.text: Zooms so the whole job fits in the view.

fields.name: Orthographic View
fields.text: Toggles a flat view without perspective.

fields.name: Show Vectors in 3D
fields.text: Toggles drawing the vectors in the 3D view.

fields.name: Show Toolpaths
fields.text: Toggles drawing the toolpaths.

fields.name: Show Model
fields.text: Toggles drawing the relief model.

fields.name: Show Material Block
fields.text: Toggles drawing the block of material.

fields.name: Orientation cube
fields.text: A small cube that turns with the camera; click a face to look at it.

fields.name: Left drag
fields.text: Turns the view around the model; Shift with the left button pans.

fields.name: Middle drag
fields.text: Pans the view.

fields.name: Right drag
fields.text: Pans in the Modern mouse scheme, zooms in the Legacy scheme (Preferences, 3D View).

fields.name: Mouse wheel
fields.text: Zooms the view in and out.

fields.name: Double click
fields.text: Selects the component under the pointer; Shift adds or removes it, empty space clears.

fields.name: Cmd or Ctrl drag
fields.text: Moves the component under the pointer.

steps: Click 3D View in the document bar.
Left drag to turn the model and scroll to zoom.
Click a face of the cube or a toolbar view button to line up the view.
Use the Show buttons to pick what the view draws.

toolDatabase.title: Tool Database
toolDatabase.summary: Keeps your cutting tools in groups with their shape and cutting data for each material and machine. Pick, add, edit, copy, import and export tools here.

fields.name: Material
fields.text: Picks the material whose cutting data the editor shows; Any material shows the tool's own data.

fields.name: Materials...
fields.text: Opens Material Management to add or rename materials.

fields.name: Machine
fields.text: Picks the machine whose feeds and speeds the editor shows.

fields.name: Machines...
fields.text: Opens Machine Configuration.

fields.name: Type of new tool
fields.text: Picks the kind of tool New Tool makes, such as End Mill, Ball Nose or V-Bit.

fields.name: New Tool
fields.text: Adds a tool of the chosen type to the selected group.

fields.name: New Group
fields.text: Adds a group to sort tools into.

fields.name: Copy
fields.text: Copies the selected tool.

fields.name: Delete
fields.text: Deletes the selected tool or group, after asking.

fields.name: Import...
fields.text: Shows the import choices: into the selected group, or merge overwriting or keeping existing data.

fields.name: Choose File...
fields.text: Picks the tool database file to import with the chosen mode.

fields.name: Export...
fields.text: Saves the tools to a file.

fields.name: Tools
fields.text: The tool list: drag tools and groups to reorder or move them; Alt with an arrow moves the selection.

fields.name: Name
fields.text: Tool editor: the tool name, built from a format; Name Format... and Variables... edit it.

fields.name: Geometry
fields.text: Tool editor: the tool shape, such as Diameter (D), angle or tip radius, and its Units.

fields.name: Cutting Parameters
fields.text: Tool editor: Pass Depth and Stepover for the chosen material and machine.

fields.name: Feeds and Speeds
fields.text: Tool editor: Spindle Speed, Feed Units, Feed Rate and Plunge Rate; Chip Load is worked out.

fields.name: Tool Number
fields.text: Tool editor: the number the machine uses for tool changes.

fields.name: Apply
fields.text: Tool editor: saves the changes to the tool.

fields.name: Add Default Tools
fields.text: Adds any of the standard tools missing from the database.

steps: Pick the Material and Machine at the top.
Select a tool in the list, or pick a type and click New Tool.
Set its geometry, cutting parameters and feeds and speeds.
Click Apply to save the tool.

machineConfiguration.title: Machine Configuration
machineConfiguration.summary: Keeps your machines with their working area, time estimate settings and the post processors they use.

fields.name: Machines
fields.text: The list of machines; the active one is marked active.

fields.name: Add Machine
fields.text: Adds a new machine.

fields.name: Duplicate
fields.text: Adds a copy of the selected machine.

fields.name: Delete
fields.text: Deletes the selected machine and the feeds and speeds saved for it.

fields.name: Name
fields.text: The machine name; each machine needs its own name.

fields.name: Units
fields.text: Millimeters or Inches for this machine's values.

fields.name: Working Area
fields.text: X travel, Y travel and Z travel of the machine, at most 100000 mm.

fields.name: Rapid Rate
fields.text: How fast the machine moves between cuts, used for time estimates.

fields.name: Acceleration units
fields.text: The unit the X, Y and Z accelerations are typed in.

fields.name: X acceleration
fields.text: With Y and Z acceleration, lets estimates follow speeding up and slowing down; zero leaves them out.

fields.name: Rotary acceleration
fields.text: Acceleration of the rotary axis in deg/s², for time estimates.

fields.name: Axis letter
fields.text: The letter your controller calls the rotary axis. A rotary job's file turns this axis.

fields.name: Axis reads
fields.text: Degrees, where once round the blank is 360, or Linear units, where once round is the blank's circumference in the post's units.

fields.name: Direction
fields.text: Reversed turns the axis the other way. Use it when a scrap cut reads mirrored on the blank.

fields.name: Associated Post Processors
fields.text: The post processors Save Toolpaths offers for this machine.

fields.name: Default for Save Toolpaths
fields.text: Marks the post processor Save Toolpaths picks first.

fields.name: Remove
fields.text: Takes a post processor off this machine's list.

fields.name: Add
fields.text: Adds the post processor chosen in Choose a post processor... to the list.

fields.name: OK
fields.text: Saves the changes and closes; Apply saves without closing, Cancel drops them.

steps: Click Add Machine and give it a name.
Enter the working area and units.
Add the post processors this machine uses and pick a default.
Click OK.

postManagement.title: Post-Processor Management
postManagement.summary: Lists the post processors that turn toolpaths into machine files. Find, view, install, customize and remove them here.

fields.name: Filter
fields.text: Shows only post processors whose name, extension or controller matches.

fields.name: Install Post-Processor...
fields.text: Picks a .pp file and adds it as a custom post processor.

fields.name: Post-processors
fields.text: The table lists Name, Extension, Units and Supports: Arcs, Laser or Rotary.

fields.name: Custom
fields.text: Badge on post processors you installed or customized.

fields.name: Details
fields.text: Shows the selected post's name, identity, extension, units, file and last change.

fields.name: View
fields.text: Shows the contents of the post processor file.

fields.name: Change Log
fields.text: Shows the post's change history (Who, When, What) from its comments.

fields.name: Customize
fields.text: Copies the post into your posts folder so you can edit it.

fields.name: Edit
fields.text: Custom posts only: opens the file in the text editor.

fields.name: Open File Location
fields.text: Custom posts only: opens the folder that holds the file.

fields.name: Delete
fields.text: Custom posts only: deletes the post processor after asking; this cannot be undone.

fields.name: Copy to Clipboard
fields.text: Copies the contents shown by View.

steps: Type in Filter to find your controller.
Select a post processor to see its details.
Click Customize to make an editable copy, or Install Post-Processor... to add one.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.summary: Application settings, in five sections: General, 2D View, 3D View, Toolpaths and Confirmations. They apply to every job.

fields.name: General
fields.text: New job units, Job Setup at start, undo steps, auto-save, tool tips, recent files and window layout.

fields.name: Default units
fields.text: The units new jobs start with.

fields.name: Auto-save every (0 = off)
fields.text: Minutes between automatic saves; 0 turns auto-save off.

fields.name: Show tool tips
fields.text: Turns the tooltips on controls on or off.

fields.name: Show usage information in the status bar
fields.text: Shows hints about the current tool at the left of the status bar.

fields.name: Show additional file operations (New, Save, Undo and Redo on the Design tab)
fields.text: Adds those icons to the Design tab.

fields.name: Remember the tab and view layout between sessions
fields.text: Reopens with the same tabs and view layout.

fields.name: 2D View
fields.text: Grid, rulers, grid style, ruler colors, the snapping in effect at start and snap radius.

fields.name: 3D View
fields.text: Background, shading, model drawing style, material look, camera animation and the orientation cube.

fields.name: Mouse Controls
fields.text: Scheme: Modern (right drag pans) or Legacy (right drag zooms).

fields.name: Toolpaths
fields.text: Calculation tolerances, toolpath list behavior, preview colors and Preview Toolpaths layout.

fields.name: Default toolpath filtering
fields.text: Whether the toolpath list starts on the Active sheet or All sheets.

fields.name: Ask before recalculating toolpaths
fields.text: Asks first when a change would recalculate toolpaths.

fields.name: Confirmations
fields.text: Which deletions and embossing warnings ask first, and what to do with crossing vectors.

fields.name: Crossing Vectors
fields.text: For V-Groove and Pocket vectors and offsets: ask, open the Vector Validator, skip or carry on.

fields.name: Reset to Defaults
fields.text: Puts every preference back to its default.

fields.name: OK
fields.text: Saves the preferences and closes; Cancel closes without the changes.

steps: Choose Options... on the Edit menu.
Pick a section on the left.
Change the settings.
Click OK to keep them.

materials.title: Material Management
materials.summary: Keeps the list of materials that tools store cutting data for. Picking a material makes it active, so toolpaths use its cutting data.

fields.name: Materials
fields.text: The list; click a material to make it active.

fields.name: Add
fields.text: Adds a new material.

fields.name: Duplicate
fields.text: Adds a copy of the active material.

fields.name: Duplicate the cutting data of every tool too
fields.text: With Duplicate, also copies each tool's cutting data for that material.

fields.name: Delete
fields.text: Deletes the active material and all cutting data kept for it, after asking.

fields.name: Name
fields.text: The name of the active material; each name must be unique.

fields.name: Rename
fields.text: Gives the active material the name typed in Name.

fields.name: Close
fields.text: Closes the dialog.

steps: Click Add, type a name and click Rename.
Click a material to make it active.
Set its cutting data in the Tool Database.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.summary: Lists every key the app answers, grouped by area, with the key names written for your computer.

fields.name: File
fields.text: Keys for new, open, save and import.

fields.name: Edit
fields.text: Keys for undo, clipboard, grouping, rotating and mirroring the selection.

fields.name: View
fields.text: Keys for the 2D and 3D views, zooming, tiling, sides and snap settings.

fields.name: Panels and tools
fields.text: Keys that open tabs, layouts and forms such as Move, Set Size and Rotate.

fields.name: Moving the selection
fields.text: Arrow keys and modifiers that nudge the selection by set distances.

fields.name: Key
fields.text: The key or keys; when a row lists several joined by or, any of them works.

fields.name: Action
fields.text: What the key does.

fields.name: Close
fields.text: Closes the dialog.

notes.title: Notes
notes.summary: Free text kept with the job, such as setup reminders or customer details.

fields.name: Notes kept with this job
fields.text: Type the notes; they are saved in the job file.

fields.name: Full stop start
fields.text: Start the notes with a full stop (.) to show them each time the job opens.

fields.name: OK
fields.text: Keeps the notes and closes.

fields.name: Cancel
fields.text: Closes without the changes.

templates.title: New from Template
templates.summary: File > New from Template starts a job from a saved template; File > Save as Template saves the current job as one.

fields.name: Template list
fields.text: Templates grouped by category, each with its size and counts of layers, vectors and toolpaths.

fields.name: Open
fields.text: Opens the picked template as a new untitled job with its setup, layers and settings.

fields.name: Template Name
fields.text: Save as Template: the name to save under; an existing name asks before replacing.

fields.name: Category
fields.text: Save as Template: optional; templates with a category are listed under it.

fields.name: Include vectors and components
fields.text: Save as Template: also keeps the drawing and model in the template.

fields.name: Include toolpaths
fields.text: Save as Template: also keeps the toolpaths in the template.

fields.name: Save
fields.text: Save as Template: saves the template to the templates folder shown below.

steps: Choose File > Save as Template and give it a name.
Pick what to include and click Save.
Later, choose File > New from Template, pick it and click Open.

vectorSelector.title: Vector Selector
vectorSelector.summary: Selects vectors by geometry and layer. The selection in the 2D view updates as you change the filters.

fields.name: Objects
fields.text: Counts the vectors picked, and how many are closed and open.

fields.name: Select open vectors
fields.text: Includes open vectors.

fields.name: Select closed vectors
fields.text: Includes closed vectors.

fields.name: Only circles
fields.text: Picks only circles.

fields.name: Circle Diameter
fields.text: With Only circles, picks circles of this size; any diameter when empty.

fields.name: Tolerance
fields.text: How far a circle's size may differ from Circle Diameter.

fields.name: All visible layers
fields.text: Picks from every visible layer; clear it to tick single layers below.

fields.name: Associate with toolpath
fields.text: From a toolpath form: the toolpath reapplies these filters whenever it is calculated.

fields.name: OK
fields.text: Keeps the filter and the selection.

steps: Choose Edit > Selection, then Vector Selector...
Tick the kinds of vectors and the layers you want.
Check the count, then click OK.

toolpathWarnings.title: Toolpath Warnings
toolpathWarnings.summary: Shows what the last toolpath calculation warned about, once it finishes. Check each point before machining.

fields.name: Toolpath name
fields.text: Each heading names the toolpath the warnings below it belong to.

fields.name: All toolpaths
fields.text: Heading for warnings that are not about one toolpath.

fields.name: OK
fields.text: Closes the dialog.

machiningTime.title: Machining Time Estimate
machiningTime.summary: Lists the estimated time of each visible toolpath and the total, with a scale factor to match your machine.

fields.name: Toolpath
fields.text: Each visible toolpath with its estimated Time.

fields.name: All visible toolpaths
fields.text: The total time of the visible toolpaths.

fields.name: Scale Factor
fields.text: Multiplies every estimate; compare an estimate with a real run to set it.

fields.name: Rapid rate
fields.text: Shows the rapid rate and machine the estimate uses, and whether accelerations are counted.

fields.name: Machine Configuration...
fields.text: Opens Machine Configuration to change the rapid rate and accelerations.

fields.name: Apply
fields.text: Saves the scale factor and updates the estimates.

fields.name: Close
fields.text: Closes the dialog.

steps: Run a job and time it on the machine.
Divide the real time by the estimate and enter it as Scale Factor.
Click Apply.

statusBar.title: Status bar
statusBar.summary: The strip along the bottom of the window. It reports the app's state, snapping, typed values, errors, the selection, the pointer position and the units.

fields.name: Status line
fields.text: Ready, Starting..., or a warning to restart; with usage information on, a hint for the current tool.

fields.name: Snap
fields.text: Names what the pointer is snapped to, such as Node, Mid, Center, Grid or Guide.

fields.name: Typed value
fields.text: Shows the value you are typing for the current tool.

fields.name: Error
fields.text: Shows the last error message, when there is one.

fields.name: selected
fields.text: How many objects are selected.

fields.name: X Y
fields.text: The pointer position in the 2D view, in job units.

fields.name: Units
fields.text: The units of the job.

menuBar.title: Menu bar
menuBar.summary: The menus along the top of the window. Each holds commands for one area of the app.

fields.name: File
fields.text: New, open, recent files, close, save, templates, print, import, export and the application data folder.

fields.name: Edit
fields.text: Undo, clipboard, selection, alignment, join, curve fit, nest, job size, notes, snap options and options.

fields.name: Model
fields.text: Create components, create from other things, import and export models, sculpt, smooth, split and properties.

fields.name: Machine
fields.text: Machine Configuration, adding machines and packages, and managing and installing post processors.

fields.name: Toolpaths
fields.text: Show the Toolpaths tab, recalculate all, preview drawing and quality, templates, merge, job sheet, materials, tool database.

fields.name: View
fields.text: Zoom to drawing, guide lines, what the 3D view draws, shading options, saving a shaded image and tiling.

fields.name: Gadgets
fields.text: Install gadgets and shortcuts, the Joint Creator, then one item per installed gadget.

fields.name: Help
fields.text: Help Contents, Keyboard Shortcuts, tutorials, release information, online links, updates and About.
